card.name: Reuters bylines: Reporting and editing by
card.fires_on: The words Reporting, Writing, Editing and the 'by' after them in the credit line at the end of a news wire story. It also fires weakly on parts of names such as Bukhari or Purdue and Berkeley after a university cue.

modes.label: Wire credit line
modes.description: Reporting, Writing or Editing, and the 'by' that follows, in the parenthetical credit at the end of a Reuters story.

modes.label: Names in citations and universities
modes.description: Middle or final part of a proper name such as Bukhari, or a university name after 'at' or 'UC'.

card.plain: It marks the 'Reporting by / Editing by' credit at the end of a news story, where a person's name comes next.
